Package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent

Class ExportTeamRequest

java.lang.Object
com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ExportTeamRequest
public final class ExportTeamRequest extends Object
Request used to export a team definition to a file or object-storage URI.

The destination location is required. An object-storage credential may be supplied when the destination requires it. Export parameters are modeled by ExportTeamParams; the database validates the destination, credential, parameters, and caller privileges.

Since:
1.1.0
